---
title: "02 -- Describe and plan"
---

Specify the sampling unit, outcome, predictors, repeated observations and
missingness strategy before choosing an analysis. Descriptive tables must show
the denominator and missingness; statistical tests require an explicit plan.

Real-data models remain disabled until mappings and scientific prerequisites
are reviewed. The separate synthetic demonstration is a rendering fixture,
not an inferred analysis of this project. Tidy, table, figure and model adapters
remain pending.
